stem: Which sentence from the article supports the idea that early frozen desserts required great effort to make?

options.label: A
options.text: The Roman emperor Nero sent his fastest runners into the mountains to gather snow.

options.label: B
options.text: The Chinese and Roman treats were unlike today’s ice cream.

options.label: C
options.text: These desserts were made with small pieces of frozen ice and were similar to snow cones.

options.label: D
options.text: When people came from Europe to America in the 1700s, they brought their recipes for ice cream with them.
